name: use-saved-views
title: useSavedViews
description: useSavedViews: the saved-views block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the saved-views block (`npx better-supabase add saved-views`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/saved-views.
